ablation.note: Same architecture, optimizer and learning rate; the physics loss is removed by zeroing its weight. The delta reflects the marginal contribution of physics consistency constraints on this dataset.

fatality_classifier.note: The 0.5 threshold on a continuous risk score is severe; with low base-rate fatalities in the synthetic dataset the F1 reflects the model's ranking capacity rather than a deployment threshold.

cross_validation.method: single stratified train/val/test split (70/15/15 by vehicle class)
cross_validation.kfold_not_used_reason: Stratified k-fold cross-validation on a 560-record synthetic dataset with a 5-output regression target and a tiny (41KB) model would add compute cost without changing the uncertainty story: the bootstrap confidence intervals on RMSE/MAE already quantify sample-size variance. A future iteration with real NHTSA records and 10x the data should switch to 5-fold CV.
